constants.resolution: resolved_brief_criterion: M >= h_c gamma_k / pi;  resolved_bessel_criterion: M >= h_c gamma_k (j_n(h gamma_k) negligible for n > h gamma_k)
constants.basis: legendre sqrt((2n+1)/(2h)) P_n(u/h), n = 0..M-1, on [-h, h], h = L/2
